content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To go on a traditional honeymoon, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Purchase foreign currency (30 minutes)
Step 2. Print out physical copies of travel insurance (10 minutes)
Step 3. Check into the honeymoon suite (15 minutes)
Step 4. Pack the final toiletries into carry-on bags (20 minutes)
Step 5. Weigh the checked luggage (5 minutes)
Step 6. Book a romantic sunset dinner cruise (20 minutes)
Step 7. Select a professional photographer for a beach session (1 hour)
Step 8. Research top-rated local excursions (3 hours)
Step 9. Finalize the daily sightseeing itinerary (4 hours)
Step 10. Confirm all restaurant reservations (30 minutes)
Step 11. Call the bank to set travel alerts on credit cards (10 minutes)
Step 12. Book airport lounge access (10 minutes)
Step 13. Purchase new swimwear and summer outfits (3 hours)
Step 14. Determine the overall honeymoon budget (2 hours)
Step 15. Renew passports if necessary (4 weeks)
Step 16. Buy a high-quality travel camera (1 hour)
Step 17. Arrange for a taxi to the airport (10 minutes)
Step 18. Charge all electronic devices and power banks (4 hours)
Step 19. Request time off from work (5 minutes)
Step 20. Set up an "Out of Office" email auto-reply (10 minutes)
Step 21. Pay the deposit for the dinner cruise (5 minutes)
Step 22. Browse travel guidebooks for inspiration (2 hours)
Step 23. Download offline maps of the destination (15 minutes)
Step 24. Research visa requirements for the destination (1 hour)
Step 25. Schedule a pre-travel haircut and spa day (3 hours)
Step 26. Create a list of emergency contact numbers (20 minutes)
Step 27. Coordinate house-sitting and mail collection (30 minutes)
Step 28. Compare different travel insurance providers (2 hours)
Step 29. Apply for an international driving permit (2 weeks)
Step 30. Pay the photography session retainer (5 minutes)

Step 37. Head to the airport for departure (1 hour)
Step 38. Check the long-range weather forecast (5 minutes)

Step 51. Organize travel documents in a folder (30 minutes)
Step 52. Select and download movies for the flight (1 hour)
Step 53. Take out the trash (10 minutes)
Step 54. Choose the honeymoon destination (1 week)
Step 55. Book the round-trip flights (1 hour)
Step 56. Confirm the pet-sitting arrangements (15 minutes)
Step 57. Set a firm wedding date to anchor the trip (1 day)
Step 58. Notify the home security company of the absence (10 minutes)
Step 59. Purchase a roaming data plan for the phone (15 minutes)
Step 60. Clean the house so it's fresh upon return (4 hours)
Step 61. Double-check that the stove and oven are off (5 minutes)
Step 62. Book the hotel accommodations (2 hours)
Step 63. Buy a journal to record memories (30 minutes)
Step 64. Look up currency exchange rates (15 minutes)
Step 65. Buy a neck pillow for the plane (20 minutes)
Step 66. Check passport expiration dates (5 minutes)
Step 67. Draft a master packing list (30 minutes)
Step 68. Reserve a rental car (30 minutes)
Step 69. Purchase travel insurance (20 minutes)
Step 70. Put the suitcases in the car trunk (10 minutes)
Step 71. Apply for the necessary travel visas (3 weeks)
Step 72. Set the home thermostat to energy-saving mode (5 minutes)
Step 73. Buy a new set of sunglasses (30 minutes)
Step 74. Research local tipping etiquette (20 minutes)
Step 75. Wash and dry all laundry (5 hours)
Step 76. Pack the photography outfits (20 minutes)
Step 77. Consult a travel agent for expert advice (2 hours)
Step 78. Coordinate the wedding day departure logistics (1 hour)
Step 79. Withdraw some cash for small tips (15 minutes)
Step 80. Buy a physical map as a backup (15 minutes)
